versions.name: Ingawanis Adventure Base

features.note: An archery range, plus an action-archery range with moving foam-disc targets.
Black powder rifles are fired at the rifle range on family night.
Cabins are rented to units during the year-round camping season.
Troop canoe floats run off site and are booked before camp.
A marking-round target range where Scouts shoot paintballs at targets.
A non-denominational worship service is held at the chapel.
A counsellor-in-training programme for youth aged fourteen and fifteen.
Low and high COPE for Scouts thirteen and over.
Trail to First Class, a morning programme for first-year campers.
Units cook breakfast and supper in their campsites midweek using food drawn from the commissary.
Provisional campers are paired with a unit for the week.
A STEM lab running programming, photography, movie-making, and space exploration.
Metalwork is taught in the skilled-trades area at the quartermaster.

versions.summary: Winnebago Council's Scouts BSA resident camp near Waverly, Iowa, with direct access to the Cedar River.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
